subject: Quote for 80 staff polos
body: Hi team, we need a quote for 80 polo shirts. Two colours on the front chest (our logo) and nothing on the back. Medium brand like the Gildan polo if possible. Needed by mid-November for a staff relaunch.

subject: Where are we up to with job 1005?
body: Just checking in on job 1005 - the 120 training tees. Our new member intake is in two weeks and I want to make sure they'll land in time. Any status update appreciated.

subject: Invoice INV-3103 payment run
body: Could you confirm the amount and due date on invoice INV-3103? It's going in our next payment run this Friday.

subject: Artwork revision for job 1007
body: We've attached a revised logo file for job 1007 - same colours but the tagline should be larger. Can you send through a fresh proof before printing?

subject: Quote needed: 150 hoodies 2-colour
body: After a quote for 150 hoodies. Two colours front, one colour back. Sizes roughly 20% S, 35% M, 30% L, 15% XL. This is for our winter range so quality matters.

subject: Invoice query - what's outstanding?
body: Our records show INV-3101 as unpaid but we thought that was settled in August. Can you check what's outstanding on our account?

subject: First order enquiry - caps
body: G'day, we're a new brewery opening in West End and want 50 caps embroidered... sorry, printed, with a small one-colour logo. What's the process and rough cost?

subject: Proof approval - job 1009
body: Proof for job 1009 looks good to us. You're approved to proceed to production.

subject: Has job 1002 shipped yet?
body: Job 1002 (the aprons) was due yesterday. Has it gone out for delivery yet? We have a supplier visit Monday and would love them in hand.

subject: Receipt for INV-3102
body: We've paid INV-3102 via transfer this morning. Please confirm receipt when it lands.

subject: Can we add 20 shirts to job 1007?
body: Before production starts on 1007, can we bump the quantity by 20 shirts and get an updated quote? Happy to pay the difference.

subject: Job 1004 colour concern
body: We received job 1004 and the green looks lighter than the proof on maybe a quarter of the run. Sending photos. What can be done?

subject: Statement request
body: Could you send a statement of our account activity for the last quarter? For our bookkeeping.

subject: Urgent - can you do 30 tees by Friday?
body: We've just been told we need 30 branded tees for a launch event this Friday. Is that physically possible and what would a rush cost?

subject: Update on delivery ETA for 1002
body: Following up from my earlier email - any ETA on 1002? No rush if it's a day out, just planning around it.

subject: Change of size breakdown before printing
body: Hey - we haven't seen a proof for 1009 yet right? Before you print, can we shift 10 shirts from M to L in the size run?

subject: Invoice has our old ABN on it
body: Invoice INV-3105 shows our old ABN. Can you reissue with the correct one so we can claim properly?

subject: Job 1010 status please
body: Where's job 1010 up to? No deadline pressure, just want to know if it's in production yet.

subject: Festival merch - quote and timeline
body: We're organising a community festival in December and need roughly 200 tote bags (1 colour) plus 100 tees (3 colours). Can you quote both and advise lead times?

subject: Payment terms on new account
body: We're setting up a new project account - what payment terms do you offer new clients, and is a deposit required on first orders?

subject: Reorder question + invoice confusion
body: We want to reorder the winter hoodies from last year, and also there's an invoice on our account I don't recognise. Can you help with both?

subject: Artwork and delivery
body: Attached is the updated artwork for our upcoming order - can you confirm you've got it and let us know when the delivery date is looking like?

subject: Membership shirts
body: Our membership is growing and we keep running out of shirts. What's the process for getting a batch done and how does pricing work at different quantities?

subject: Friday's batch
body: Can you make sure Friday's batch is right this time? Last few things have had small issues and we can't afford a reprint again.

subject: New staff kits
body: We onboard staff every month and want a welcome kit - shirts and a cap each. What would something like that look like, and can we put it on our existing account?

subject: Quote for brewery towels
body: Following the tees quote - can you also price 40 bar towels with a small one-colour print? Different job, just exploring options.

subject: Job 1012 - proof looks wrong
body: Proof for 1012 has our old logo. We sent the new one last month. Please regenerate the proof with the current brand file before anything prints.

subject: Overdue reminder on INV-3098
body: Noticed a reminder for INV-3098 - we believe this was paid. Can you reconcile and confirm the account is clear?

subject: Delivery window for job 1011
body: Job 1011 - what delivery window should we expect? Just working out building access for the courier.

subject: Sizing samples before we commit
body: Before we commit to 200 totes and 100 tees, do you provide sizing samples so we can check the fit? Also what's your turnaround if we approve artwork next week?
